cloud-canvas.$description: Cloud Canvas — Page background, quiet footer bands, subdued action surfaces

white-surface.$description: White Surface — Header, inputs, search surfaces, elevated content fields

divider-ash.$description: Divider Ash — 1px structural dividers, card outlines, and header separation

input-steel.$description: Input Steel — Input borders and stronger contained-surface outlines

charcoal-panel.$description: Charcoal Panel — Dark product-preview panels and dark icon or text treatment

ink.$description: Ink — Headlines, prominent body copy, dark outlined controls

graphite-copy.$description: Graphite Copy — Secondary body copy and descriptive text

slate-navigation.$description: Slate Navigation — Navigation labels, utility links, muted metadata, and subdued icons

electric-signal.$description: Electric Signal — Filled CTA buttons, text links, directional arrows, and active interface marks — the saturated blue cuts through the otherwise restrained canvas

blue-mist.$description: Blue Mist — Pale blue card fields and quiet highlighted-control backgrounds

peach-paper.$description: Peach Paper — Warm card surfaces and pale decorative panel backgrounds

lilac-wash.$description: Lilac Wash — Pale purple product-card surfaces

orchid-edge.$description: Orchid Edge — Pastel purple feature-card borders

sky-edge.$description: Sky Edge — Pastel blue feature-card borders

tangerine-edge.$description: Tangerine Edge — Pastel orange feature-card borders

horizon-wash.$description: Horizon Wash — Hero atmosphere behind centered messaging — a diffuse warm-to-cool transition rather than a button or panel treatment

poppins.$description: Display and section-heading family. Semibold Poppins creates the site’s broad geometric headline silhouette; the -0.025em tracking at major sizes pulls its round letterforms into compact, high-density statements.

inter.$description: Body, navigation, links, input text, buttons, and utility metadata. Use 16px/24px regular for reading copy, 13px/19.5px medium for primary navigation, 14px/20px medium for account controls, and 18px/28px semibold for compact plan statements.
